title.zh: 将北苏里高省境内Socorro至Nueva Estrella至Pamosaingan描笼涯的公路路段全线改设为国家次级公路的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Socorro - Nueva Estrella - Barangay Pamosaingan Road, Province of Surigao Del Norte Into a National Secondary Road
title.orig: An Act Converting the Socorro - Nueva Estrella - Barangay Pamosaingan Road, Province of Surigao Del Norte Into a National Secondary Road

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2010/ra_10096_2010.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Socorro - Nueva Estrella - Barangay Pamosaingan Road, Province of Surigao del Norte is hereby converted into a national secondary road.
The Secretary of the Department of Public Works and Highways shall issue the necessary rules, orders and circulars to implement the provision of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in a newspaper of general circulation.
